headline: Suno AI music generator sued again for copyright infringement
claim: Training AI on copyrighted songs harms songwriters and the music industry.
notes: published 2026-11-08; covers the Presley rights holders' and Eight Mile Style's separate suits against Suno. Allegations only; no court has ruled. Plaintiffs are rights holders (interested parties). Suno told Variety it does not allow unauthorized use of artists' work. Engadget does not state a damages figure for the Suno suits; the $41M it mentions is from the Presley suit against Anthropic, which conflicts with the $41M sought from Suno in the Detroit Free Press syndication logged 2026-11-08.

headline: Stratos Data Center Will Emit Air Pollution That's Linked to Premature Deaths and Health Economic Damages for Utah & States Downwind
claim: Pollution from a planned data center is linked to premature deaths and health damages in Utah and downwind states.
notes: published 2026-11-03; byline John Walke, NRDC (advocacy group, interested party). Modeled projection by EmPower Analytics for NRDC, not a measured outcome: about 5-45 additional premature deaths and $75-$690 million in health damages a year at full build-out (9 GW). The article does not say the facility serves AI workloads; logged because it is a data center and the watcher covers the electricity and energy topic. NRDC's own release returned 403.
